cohort: 1807 births among women with JIA compared to 1,949,202 control births in Sweden between 1992 and 2011
finding: Women with both childhood-onset and adult-onset JIA had an increased risk of pregnancy complications, including preterm birth and pre-eclampsia, compared to women without JIA.
mod_finding: Women with JIA paediatric only were at increased risk of delivery by caesarean section and induction of labor.
